options.opa: Pyruvate is converted into lactate in the liver.

analysis: The Cori cycle involves the conversion of lactate produced in skeletal muscles during anaerobic glycolysis into glucose in the liver. This process helps in maintaining blood glucose levels and provides energy to muscles during intense exercise. In the liver, lactate is converted back into pyruvate, which is then used to synthesize glucose through gluconeogenesis.
